eday.name.pres-nass.ha: Zaɓen Shugaban Ƙasa da na Majalisar Ƙasa
eday.name.pres-nass.ig: Ntuli aka Onye Isi Ala na nke Ụlọ Omebe Iwu Mba
eday.name.pres-nass.yo: Ìdìbò Ààrẹ àti ti Ilé Aṣòfin Orílẹ̀-èdè

eday.remind.days.title.ig: Ụbọchị ntuli aka ga-abịa n’ime ụbọchị {n}
eday.remind.days.title.yo: Ó ku ọjọ́ {n} sí Ọjọ́ ìdìbò

eday.remind.days.when.ha: {election}: {date}. Za a fara zaɓe da ƙarfe {time} {zone}.

eday.remind.hours.title.ha: Za a fara zaɓe cikin awa {n}

eday.remind.hours.when.ha: {election}: za a fara zaɓe da ƙarfe {time} {zone} a yau.
eday.remind.hours.when.yo: {election}: ìdìbò yóò bẹ̀rẹ̀ ní agogo {time} {zone} lónìí.

eday.remind.unit.en: Stay for the count at {unit}, and photograph the result sheet when it is posted.
eday.remind.unit.ha: Ka tsaya domin ƙidaya a {unit}, ka kuma ɗauki hoton Takardar Sakamako idan an liƙa ta.
eday.remind.unit.ig: Nọrọ maka ọgụgụ na {unit}, ma see foto nke mpempe akwụkwọ nsonaazụ mgbe e gosiri ya ọha.
eday.remind.unit.yo: Dúró fún ìkà ní {unit}, kí o sì ya fọ́tò Ìwé Àbájáde nígbà tí wọ́n bá lẹ̀ ẹ́.

eday.remind.nounit.en: You have not saved a polling unit yet. Save yours in Hawkeye now so you are ready to report from it.
eday.remind.nounit.ha: Ba ka ajiye rukunin zaɓe ba tukuna. Ajiye naka a Hawkeye yanzu domin ka shirya aika rahoto daga can.
eday.remind.nounit.ig: Ị chekwabeghị ngalaba ntuli aka ọ bụla. Chekwaa nke gị na Hawkeye ugbu a ka ị dị njikere ịkọ akụkọ site n’ebe ahụ.
eday.remind.nounit.yo: O kò tíì fi ẹ̀ka ìdìbò kankan pamọ́. Fi tìrẹ pamọ́ sí Hawkeye nísinsìnyí kí o lè múra láti jábọ̀ láti ibẹ̀.

pnudge.body.en: Rehearse reporting a result on a practice polling unit before polling day. Nothing you enter counts as a real result.
pnudge.body.ha: Gwada aika sakamako a rukunin zaɓe na atisaye kafin Ranar zaɓe. Babu abin da ka shigar da zai zama sakamako na gaske.
pnudge.body.ig: Mee omume ịkọ nsonaazụ na ngalaba ntuli aka omume tupu Ụbọchị ntuli aka. Ọ dịghị ihe ị tinyere ga-agụ dị ka ezigbo nsonaazụ.
pnudge.body.yo: Ṣe àdánwò jíjábọ̀ àbájáde ní ẹ̀ka ìdìbò àdánwò kí Ọjọ́ ìdìbò tó dé. Kò sí ohun tí o bá tẹ̀ sí i tí yóò kà gẹ́gẹ́ bí àbájáde gidi.
